feature.name: service-catalog-prefill
feature.summary: Adds an optional 'Load from Existing App' selector to the Custom Infrastructure form (CustomInfrastructurePage.vue) that pre-populates Step 0 (Project Information) and Step 1 (Module Selection) with data sourced from docs/metadata/{appName}-{environment}.json in the Aya-DevOpsTeam/service-catalog repository. Includes a new authenticated GET /api/app-metadata/:appName/:environment endpoint, a bug fix to getApplicationDetails() file-naming in infrastructureService.js, a new AppSelector.vue reusable component, a new apiService.getAppMetadata() frontend method, and TypeScript type enrichment. Template Deploy pre-fill (TemplateDeployPage.vue) is explicitly out of scope for this release.

user_stories.so_that: I can re-provision or modify infrastructure in under 30 seconds without manually retyping all metadata
acceptance_criteria: An optional 'Load from Existing App' section appears at the top of Step 0 on CustomInfrastructurePage.vue, labelled and collapsible
The app dropdown is populated from GET /api/installed-apps within 3 000 ms of component mount
Selecting an app name reveals a second dropdown scoped to that app's available environments with no additional API call
Clicking Load fetches metadata from GET /api/app-metadata/:appName/:environment and shows a spinner until complete
After successful load: projectName, descriptiveName, environment, owner are pre-filled in ProjectInfoForm.vue
After successful load: selectedModules in Step 1 reflects metadata.modules
projectAge and approvalNumber remain blank after pre-fill (must be entered fresh per request)
lifecycle is NOT pre-filled (always forced to 'experimental' by ProjectInfoForm.vue)
A dismissible banner '📋 Pre-filled from {appName} / {environment}' appears after successful load
All pre-filled fields remain fully editable before submission
If form already has data, a confirmation dialog warns before overwriting

HTTP 400 for appName outside /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,8}$/ or environment not in data/environments.json
HTTP 401 for unauthenticated requests
HTTP 404 when the metadata file does not exist
correlationId is present in every response and every log line for the request

api_endpoints.description: Returns normalized metadata for a single app/environment pair from docs/metadata/{appName}-{environment}.json in Aya-DevOpsTeam/service-catalog

request_schema.environment: string (path param) — value from data/environments.json allowlist

validation: appName must match /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,8}$/ — return HTTP 400 if not (before GitHub call)
environment must be in data/environments.json — return HTTP 400 if not (before GitHub call)

errors.condition: appName fails regex or environment not in allowlist
errors.message: { success: false, error: 'Invalid appName or environment', correlationId }

errors.condition: missing or invalid JWT bearer token

errors.message: { success: false, error: 'App not found', correlationId }
{ success: false, error: 'Failed to fetch metadata', correlationId }

api_endpoints.description: Reused as-is to populate AppSelector app list. No route or response changes.
Route signature unchanged. Underlying getApplicationDetails() is fixed by FR-007, so response shape changes from raw GitHub JSON to normalized shape. Audit existing consumers before deploying.

AppMetadata.description: Matches the data object shape returned by GET /api/app-metadata. Used by AppSelector.vue and CustomInfrastructurePage.vue prefill wiring.
validation: name: /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,8}$/ enforced server-side before GitHub call
environment: must match a value from data/environments.json

added_fields.costCenter: string? — from meta.cost_center in metadata file
added_fields.commitSha: string? — from meta.commit_sha in metadata file

service_catalog_source_file.description: Canonical metadata written by infrastructure workflows. Read-only from self-service-infra's perspective.

key_fields.project: app name (also projectName in legacy files)
key_fields.meta.name: string

backend.description: Add GET /api/app-metadata/:appName/:environment route with requireAuth, express-validator input validation, and call to infrastructureService.getApplicationDetails(). Existing routes unchanged.
FR-007: Fix getApplicationDetails() — change primary lookup from docs/metadata/{projectName}.json to docs/metadata/{projectName}-{environment}.json. Normalize return shape.
fixed_strategy: Fallback (only if primary 404): list docs/metadata/ and scan for matching project+environment
Return null if neither finds a match
Return shape: { name, environment, description, owner, lifecycle, modules, costCenter, commitSha, deployedAt }

frontend.description: New reusable Vue 3 component. Encapsulates app list loading, two-level selection (app → env), metadata fetch, and event emission.
behavior: Mount: call apiService.getInstalledApps(); cache InstalledApp[] for page lifetime
Derive unique app name list from cached data
App name selection: reset env dropdown; repopulate from cached list for that app (no API call)
Load button: enabled only when both app name and environment selected
Load click: call apiService.getAppMetadata(appName, env); show spinner; disable button
Success: emit @prefill(metadata); show dismissible banner '📋 Pre-filled from {appName} / {environment}'
Second load: show confirmation dialog before overwriting
Empty list: render 'No apps found' with retry button
Section collapsible; collapse does not affect parent form state
accessibility: Errors: aria-describedby linking error text to control

changes: Add watch on prefillData: set formData.projectName=metadata.name, formData.descriptiveName=metadata.description, formData.environment=metadata.environment, formData.owner=metadata.owner
Import and render <AppSelector> above <ProjectInfoForm> in Step 0 panel
Handle @prefill: store metadata in local ref; pass as :prefillData to ProjectInfoForm; set selectedModules = metadata.modules
Handle @error: display error message in Step 0 banner area
Add to apiService: getAppMetadata: (appName: string, environment: string): Promise<ApiResponse> => api.get(`/api/app-metadata/${appName}/${environment}`)

Add new interface AppMetadata: { name: string; environment: string; description: string; owner: string; lifecycle: string; modules: string[]; costCenter: string; commitSha: string; deployedAt: string }

flows.name: Pre-fill Happy Path — Custom Infrastructure
steps: AppSelector.vue mounts → apiService.getInstalledApps() called → InstalledApp[] cached
User expands 'Load from Existing App' section, selects app name from searchable dropdown
Environment dropdown auto-populates from cached list (no API call)
User selects environment, clicks Load → spinner shown, button disabled
Route: validate inputs (400 if invalid) → call infrastructureService.getApplicationDetails()
Normalized AppMetadata returned → route wraps in {success:true, data, correlationId} → HTTP 200
AppSelector emits @prefill(metadata) → CustomInfrastructurePage sets prefillData + selectedModules
ProjectInfoForm watcher fires → projectName, descriptiveName, environment, owner set
User fills in projectAge and approvalNumber, proceeds through wizard normally

performance.metadata_fetch_latency: GET /api/app-metadata/:appName/:environment ≤ 2 000 ms at p95 (GitHub API available, ≤50 concurrent users)
performance.app_list_load_time: AppSelector.vue populated within 3 000 ms of mount at p95 from GET /api/installed-apps
performance.validation_overhead: HTTP 400 responses for invalid inputs returned before any GitHub API call (<10 ms)
performance.measurement: api_request_completed telemetry event (duration_ms field) emitted automatically by Axios interceptors in srcV2/services/api.ts

reliability.graceful_degradation: If GET /api/app-metadata or GET /api/installed-apps returns 4xx/5xx: (1) form remains fully functional for manual entry; (2) human-readable error message appears within 500 ms; (3) error logged server-side with correlationId
reliability.github_retries: GitHub 5xx errors retried 3x with exponential backoff per platform convention before returning 500
reliability.no_n_plus_1_calls: A single pre-fill action must result in exactly 1 GitHub getContent API call when primary lookup path succeeds

security.auth_enforcement: GET /api/app-metadata protected by requireAuth middleware — HTTP 401 for unauthenticated requests, no metadata payload returned
security.input_validation: appName validated against /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,8}$/ server-side; environment validated against data/environments.json allowlist; HTTP 400 before any GitHub call
security.no_sensitive_logging: correlationId, appName, environment may be logged; JWT tokens, GitHub tokens, and secret values must never be logged

observability.correlation_ids: Every backend log line for the new route and service method must include req.correlationId; correlationId must appear in all response JSON objects

accessibility.wcag_21_aa: AppSelector.vue must meet WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard-navigable (Tab/Arrow/Enter), loading state announced via aria-busy or aria-live, error messages linked via aria-describedby

usability.prefill_banner_visibility: Pre-fill confirmation banner visible without scrolling at 375 px, 768 px, and 1 280 px viewport widths; persists until dismissed or user navigates to a new step
